criteria.acceptance: 257 independent oracle comparisons, 19 boundary groups, 84 existing rules and 5 reference cases pass

criteria.criterion: Reproducibility and Studio / Reprodutibilidade e Studio
criteria.acceptance: 8 Studio checks, 8 transfers and 10 provenance/guard checks; snapshots and seeded cases

criteria.criterion: Automated usability and accessibility / Usabilidade e acessibilidade automatizadas
criteria.acceptance: 97 browser checks, no page errors; selected contrast ≥4.5:1 text and ≥3:1 controls, keyboard, 320px and reduced motion

criteria.criterion: Privacy and security controls / Privacidade e controles
criteria.acceptance: 12 boundary checks; local subresources, blocked fetch and text-only import; no declared extension permissions
two reproducible builds, source parity, CRC, fixed historical hashes and same installed ZIP hash
actual unpacked extension registered, four tools and JSON export

criteria.criterion: Identity and free distribution / Identidade e gratuidade
criteria.acceptance: official symbol and icon assets and historical downloads unchanged in diff; dark wine UI, no payment/account requirement

criteria.criterion: Windows Chrome and Edge / Chrome e Edge no Windows
criteria.acceptance: both clean authorized profiles, four tools, language, clipboard/export, reload and uninstall; exact hash evidence
criteria.evidence: Maintainer-reported group acceptance, 2026-11-27; Chrome and Edge on Windows reported passed for 1.0.1. Individual clean profile, exact hash check, clipboard/export, reload and uninstall observations not supplied. No independent rerun.

criteria.acceptance: Defender scan of exact ZIP and extracted files, recorded engine, definitions, time, results and no unresolved detections
criteria.evidence: Maintainer-reported group acceptance, 2026-11-27; Updated Defender reported no detections for 1.0.1. Raw logs, engine/definition versions, scan time and per-target results not supplied. No independent rerun.

criteria.criterion: Manual visual and accessibility review / Revisão visual e acessibilidade manual
criteria.acceptance: review desktop/mobile and popup, keyboard-only and screen-reader checks; no unresolved critical or high-severity accessibility issues
criteria.evidence: Maintainer-reported group acceptance, 2026-11-27; Visual, keyboard and accessibility review reported passed for 1.0.1. Individual viewport, popup and screen-reader results not supplied. No independent rerun.

score_scope: Historical internal candidate acceptance: 7 points from CI/source review and 3 from maintainer-reported groups; not institutional evidence maturity, independent certification, or proof every listed manual subcase was executed. Release authorization is historical and applies only to the tested candidate.
